abstract.para: This section covers recommended post-deployment tasks for your &sleminvm;.

topic.para: After successfully deploying and configuring your &sleminvm;, the system is running and ready for use. To ensure optimal security and localization, perform the following post-deployment tasks.

section.title: Registering the system
section.para: Registering your &sleminvm; links it to your &suse; subscription. If the system was not registered during first boot, register it manually.
You can also register with &rmt; using the setup script. For more information, see Configuring clients with rmt-client-setup.

section.title: Changing the system locale
section.para: By default, the &sleminvm; image includes only the en_US locale. To use a different system language, install and select your desired locale. The following example commands configure the system for the de_DE locale.

section.title: Removing setup packages
section.para: &jeosfirstboot; and the packages it pulls in are only required for the initial configuration of the system. note.title: Configuration tools are removed as well
note.para: The command removes &jeosfirstboot; along with dependencies, including configuration tools such as jeos-config or ssh-pairing. If you still need any of these tools, keep &jeosfirstboot; installed.
